rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the prison as an institution or place.

example.english: This prison is specifically for holding serious offenders.
example.traditional: 呢座監獄專門收押重犯。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 gaam1 juk6 zyun1 mun4 sau1 aap3 cung5 faan6

rows.note: A Hong Kong speaker uses this colloquial word for the jail itself, especially in casual speech.

example.english: They have been in prison for several months.
example.jyutping: keoi5 jap6 zo2 gaam1 cong1 gei2 go3 jyut6 laa3

rows.note: This is an established but less everyday alternative for the prison as a place of confinement.

example.english: They were sent to prison for a serious crime.
example.jyutping: keoi5 jan1 cung5 zeoi6 bei6 sung3 jap6 gaam1 lou4

rows.note: This refers to the state or experience of being confined, especially in legal or formal contexts.

example.english: The court sentenced them to three years in prison.
example.jyutping: faat3 ting4 pun3 cyu3 keoi5 gaam1 gam3 saam1 nin4
